heading: About Us

About Us

About our company

Welcome to ThePaymaster®

ThePaymaster® is a pioneering platform designed to handle profit shares and commission payments for intermediaries involved in high-value transactions.

We bring a new level of transparency and security through blockchain technology, minting a unique Transaction NFT at the end of each transaction to authenticate the process.

Additionally, ThePaymaster® ensures a seamless experience for users by leveraging trusted partners like HSBC and SumSub.

Trust In Every Transaction

ThePaymaster® is designed to handle transactions of £1,000,000 and above.

Confidence In Every Step

We support transactions as low as £250,000 regardless of the transaction size.

WORK WITH US

Who can use ThePaymaster®?

ThePaymaster® is designed for intermediaries such as agents, brokers, and consultants who are beneficiaries of high-value transactions. Our platform primarily serves individuals and companies involved in large transactions, including sellers in real estate, sports, and commodity deals.

⁠How much does it cost to use ThePaymaster®?

We offer a simple, transparent fee structure: 1% of the total transaction amount. No upfront fees. It is paid as part of the transfer process. This fee applies to all transactions, regardless of size, and there are no hidden fees in the normal course of business. In some cases, particularly complex company structures may incur additional fees to complete and pass KYC and AML processing.

Which industries does ThePaymaster® support?

ThePaymaster® specializes in high-value transactions across various industries, including real estate, sports, commodities, and Private Placement Programs (PPPs). Our platform supports both one-off payments and recurring transactions, especially for long-term arrangements like PPPs.

⁠How does blockchain and Transaction NFT technology work on ThePaymaster?

At the end of each transaction, ThePaymaster® mints a Transaction NFT that serves as a digital record, permanently logged on the blockchain. This guarantees transparency, ensuring that all parties can trust the process and refer back to the transaction at any time.

Future Developments

ThePaymaster® continues to innovate:

• Full automation coming Q2 2025

• Enhanced platform features in development• Additional regulatory umbrella through Stripe Connect in Q1 2025

Our partners

Our trusted partners

ThePaymaster works with trusted platforms like Revolt Business Banking, HSBC Banking and SumSub. These partnerships ensure secure transactions, robust compliance, and global scalability.
